items.t: Issued a statement describing the outcome involving Planned Parenthood in Lubbock as a pro-life victory.
items.q: Sen. Charles Perry's Statement Regarding the Pro-Life Victory Over Planned Parenthood in Lubbock

items.t: Authored Senate Bill 3, Banning THC in Texas.
items.q: following the bipartisan passage of Senate Bill 3, Banning THC in Texas, by Sen. Charles Perry, R-Lubbock

record.t: Authored Senate Bill 3, which bans Delta 8, Delta 9, and all other forms of intoxicating THC in Texas.
record.q: Senate Bill 3, by Sen. Charles Perry, prohibits the retail sale of any cannabinoid in Texas, except CBD and CBG. SB 3 bans Delta 8, Delta 9, and all other forms of intoxicating THC, including beverages.

record.t: Served as Vice Chair of the General Investigating committee on the July 2025 flooding events.
record.q: July 2025 Flooding Events, General Investigating (Vice Chair)

record.t: Was appointed to the 2021 Redistricting Committee.
record.q: Sen. Charles Perry Appointed To The 2021 Redistricting Committee

record.t: Was elected in a 9/9/2014 special election to the Texas Senate and sworn in 9/30/2014, succeeding Robert Duncan's unexpired term.
record.q: In Senate, Charles Perry, in special election 9/9/2014, sworn 9/30/2014, succeeded unexpired term of Robert Duncan, resigned 7/3/2014.

record.t: Chairs the Senate Committee on Water, Agriculture, and Rural Affairs and is Vice-Chair of the Senate Health and Human Services Committee.
record.q: Sen. Perry currently chairs the Senate Committee on Water, Agriculture, and Rural Affairs and is Vice-Chair of the Senate Health and Human Services Committee.

record.t: Serves as co-chair of the State Water Implementation Fund for Texas (SWIFT) Advisory Committee and the Texas Infrastructure Resiliency Fund (TIRF).
record.q: He also sits on the Senate Committees for Finance, State Affairs, and Transportation, and he co-chairs the State Water Implementation Fund for Texas (SWIFT) Advisory Committee and the Texas Infrastructure Resiliency Fund (TIRF).

record.t: Was appointed by Governor Abbott to the Southwestern States Water Commission and the Western States Water Council.
record.q: Governor Abbott appointed him to the Southwestern States Water Commission and the Western States Water Council.

record.t: Passed a hemp bill out of the Senate.
record.q: Sen. Charles Perry Passes "The Hemp" Bill Out Of The Senate

record.t: Served as Senate President Pro Tempore in the 89th Legislature.
